# Jurisdiction (`jurisdiction` v1)

A country: electoral system, legislature, government and headline social indicators.

**Group:** Politics and society · **Mnemonic:** `JUR` · **Identifiers:** `JUR-…` in `jurisdictionId`

Open one with `JUR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: jurisdiction
version: 1
description: "A country: electoral system, legislature, government and headline social indicators."
match: { kind: jurisdiction, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Politics and society · Jurisdiction, id: $.jurisdictionId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Capital, bind: $.capital }
  - { label: Population (m), bind: $.populationM, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Electoral system, bind: $.system }
  - { label: Seats, bind: $.seats, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Government, bind: $.government }
panels:
  - id: legislature
    kind: hbar
    title: Seats in the legislature
    key: F2
    rows: $.legislature
    label: party
    value: seats
    fmt: amount0
  - id: indicators
    kind: kv
    title: Indicators
    key: F3
    area: right
    rows: $.indicators
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.lastElection, 'election')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
